scripts/map_orient.py written. Frozen exit table 0/10/11/12/13 sits strictly above argparse(2) and traceback(1) and strictly below 126/127, so no verdict can be confused with a mistyped flag, a crash, or a missing POSIX shell. Gotcha found: importlib-loaded modules need sys.modules[name]=module before exec_module or frozen dataclasses raise on 3.14 - the test loader must do this.

<repo-root> added to resolve_spine and to _RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE. DEVIATION from the handoff's literal 'str(Path(root).resolve())': emitted as Path(root).resolve().as_posix(). Evidence - a spine is JSON and instantiate_spine json.loads() its own output, so a Windows str(Path) value 'C:\Programs\...' makes that guard raise 'Invalid \escape', proven by direct run; as_posix() parses fine and is also correct for the POSIX shell the engine runs command checks under. Justification comment says ROBUSTNESS (checks receive no cwd and inherit the launcher's; the five shipped relative checks are fragile, not broken, and are left alone per #341). Falsifiability spot-checked: mutating the resolver back to str(Path(...)) makes the json-safe test go red.

tests/test_mutation_floor.py: 7 passed, 4 subtests. The applied-assertion runs FIRST and is a strict count delta, not an 'in' check: original.count(old)==1, mutated.count(old)==0, mutated.count(new)==original.count(new)+1. Each kill additionally requires (a) passed_count>0 so a broken import cannot count as a kill and (b) a FAILED node in the class the mutation was supposed to break. why_trail.why: REWORK B1 fixed. Root cause: pin_substitutes emitted the sentinel content_hash='unreadable' and substitutes_declared only asked 'is it non-filler', so a nonexistent substitute path discharged the record at exit 0 (reproduced independently before touching anything: orient exit 0, verify exit 0). Fix has two halves so neither alone can regress it: (1) pin_substitutes now records content_hash=null for an unreadable path, no sentinel; (2) new pure predicate is_content_hash validates the pin by SHAPE (64 hex chars), so no sentinel, typo or truncated digest can stand in for a pin. New substitute_problems() names the offending entry in stderr. Post-fix repro: orient exit 10, verify exit 10, receipt content_hash null, stderr names THIS_FILE_DOES_NOT_EXIST. New UnreadableSubstitute class, 6 tests incl. the reviewer's exact repro and a positive control that a real substitute still discharges at 0. B2 half-one done too: multi-element filler cases added, since single-element lists cannot tell 'not any' from 'not all'. tests/test_map_orient.py 51 passed / 32 subtests, was 42/22.

Cascade-reset by the m2 reopen; re-evidenced unchanged. The <repo-root> work was adjudicated ACCEPTED by commander and reviewer (as_posix confirmed necessary; the test addition confirmed 53 insertions / 0 deletions) and is out of rework scope, so no code change. Check re-run fresh: tests/test_init_work_area.py 31 passed.

REWORK B2 fixed. Reviewer's M4 (unmapped_declared 'not any'->'not all') independently confirmed SURVIVING the shipped floor: applied cleanly, floor exit 0, 42 passed, 0 failed. Cause confirmed as stated - every filler case in both self_test and PartialFillMatrix used a SINGLE-element list, where any and all are identical, so the floor could not distinguish them. Fixed by adding multi-element cases (['none', real], [real, 'n/a'], ['none','n/a'], [real,'',real]) plus an all-real positive control, and M4 is now pinned in the shipped set. Also pinned M5, the B1 blocker itself (is_content_hash shape check weakened to bool(value.strip())), so the blocker cannot silently return - flagged to commander as a judgment call since B2 asked only for M4. Post-fix, all 5 mutations killed with an in-target failure each: all->any exit 1 (42 passing, 10 in-target); UNRESOLVABLE-ROOT collapse exit 1 (39 passing, 2 in-target); citability->existence exit 1 (41 passing, 3 in-target); M4 exit 1 (50 passing, killed by exactly the new test_one_filler_poisons_a_multi_element_unmapped_list); M5 exit 1 (49 passing, 2 in-target). tests/test_mutation_floor.py 9 passed / 6 subtests.
